role: desktop menu plate for the locked 320x70 box
not: a slice or stretch of button-steel-rest, and not a shrink of the box
covers: the drawing is opaque to all four edges, so contain fills the box and no background shows at the edges or corners
fit: uniform scale to width 1538, vertical centre crop to height 294, then the centre length removed to the measured box width; uniform resample only, never 100% 100%
pressed: same pixels, lighting only, no second drawing
webp: libwebp quality 82; opaque lossy VP8, no alpha channel
tool: cx built-in image_gen, account2, no PixelLab
